about: General maths facts that the atlas's proofs rest on: Lean core and Mathlib facts, names Lean writes itself inside the proofs, and set.mm facts under the two Metamath probability checks. They are not AI-safety records, so the atlas's records, graph, search and counts leave them out; they are kept here with every recorded link that touches them, so each proof still shows what it stands on. Each fact keeps its recorded state; links are machine-extracted dependencies, read as: source depends on target.

decision.rule: Move out records that are not relevant to AI safety and will never be used; keep anything that can connect to, support or be used by AI-safety work later.
